messages.subject: For John | Energy Transition and Natural Resources Executive | International Mobility
messages.body:
Dear John,

Your work across energy transition and natural resources in EMEA makes this a focused introduction. I am pursuing senior international mandates where government relations, ESG, stakeholder strategy and country-facing execution support energy, resources and infrastructure growth.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group in Guyana. My current mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate affairs, executive communications and cross-functional stakeholder leadership. I work across ministries, regulators, communities and internal functions to convert external requirements into accountable actions and evidence.

My target universe includes energy and utility platforms such as Equinor, EDP and comparable businesses, as well as mining, metals and industrial groups undergoing energy transition. My experience includes stakeholder coordination around large-scale solar and battery storage, carbon-data governance, responsible mining and public-sector engagement. I am globally mobile and open to expatriate, residential and rotational assignments.

My executive CV is attached. I would value consideration for current or future searches where energy-transition exposure, institutional leadership and emerging-market execution fit the mandate.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
https://ragunauthramsaroop.com/
https://www.linkedin.com/in/ragunauth-ramsaroop/

messages.subject: For Raffaello | Energy and Industrial Executive | ESG, External Affairs and Global Mobility
messages.body:
Dear Raffaello,

Your work across Energy and Industrial EMEA, including energy-transition leadership, makes this a focused introduction. I am exploring Director, Senior Director, Head and VP-track mandates where external affairs, government relations, ESG and strategic stakeholder execution support transformation and growth.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group in Guyana. My remit integrates government and regulatory engagement, ESG and social performance, corporate affairs, executive communications, strategic partnerships and cross-functional delivery in a complex mining operation. Across 12+ years, I have also worked in regulated financial services and commercial operations.

My target universe includes multinational energy and industrial platforms such as Equinor, Siemens, Eaton, ArcelorMittal and EDP, along with comparable businesses across the Middle East and Europe. I bring direct exposure to renewable-energy and battery-storage stakeholder coordination, carbon-data governance and responsible resource development. I am globally mobile and open to relocation, expatriate and rotational assignments.

My executive CV is attached. I would welcome consideration for searches where institutional judgment, responsible-business execution and country-facing leadership are central to the role.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
